# What React Solves

#### Course: Build your First Web App with React

## What React Solves

So you now have some idea of how fragile plain JavaScript code can be. Fortunately for us, React is here to save the day!

This framework gives you a different mental model: you describe what the UI should look like, and React updates the DOM for you.

Instead of manually creating and removing elements, you write a function that returns the UI based on your data. When the data changes, React figures out what to update.

![React's Mental Model](data:image/png;base64,)

Next, we'll clarify this by building the same shopping list with React.
